summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face, which now hosts over 3 million public models (crossing that milestone in August 2026), and a growing set of developer-facing inference platforms that make open-weight models instantly usable via API without self-hosting. Download distribution is highly concentrated—roughly half of Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads—and the geographic center of gravity is shifting, with China surpassing the U.S. in monthly model downloads. Platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow compete on speed, price-per-token, local vs. cloud deployment, and breadth of supported open models.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub and community platform for hosting, sharing, discovering, and running open AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), with an Inference API and serverless/dedicated endpoints.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, adding ~747,000 in the first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited Inference API; PRO subscription (~$9/month); pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise plans for teams.
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting demos and apps (Gradio/Streamlit)
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Model cards, download stats, and community discussions
Git-based versioning for model weights
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and tooling in one ecosystem.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool and lightweight runtime for downloading and running open-weight LLMs locally on personal machines or servers with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated open models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.) plus custom GGUF imports
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; you provide your own hardware. Optional Ollama cloud/hosted offerings may carry usage fees.
features: One-command local model download and run
Local OpenAI-compatible REST API
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
GGUF quantized model support for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
Strong privacy since inference runs locally
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want to run LLMs privately and offline on their own hardware with minimal setup.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform that lets developers run and fine-tune open-source models via API, with a focus on image, video, audio, and multimodal generation as well as LLMs.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published and official models packaged with Cog
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU runtime); no idle costs for serverless runs.
features: Run any model via a single API call
Cog packaging for reproducible model containers
Supports image/video/audio generation and LLMs
Custom model deployment and fine-tuning
Automatic scaling and webhooks
Public model gallery with runnable demos
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting to integrate generative and multimodal models via API without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance cloud inference and training platform offering fast, low-cost APIs for a large catalog of open-source LLMs and multimodal models, plus fine-tuning and dedicated GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); dedicated endpoints and GPU cluster rentals billed hourly; fine-tuning priced by tokens/compute.
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Optimized high-throughput, low-latency serving
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Broad catalog of chat, code, image, and embedding models
Competitive per-token pricing
platforms.best_for: Companies and developers building production applications on open models who need scalable, affordable inference and training.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform focused on blazing-fast, production-grade serving of open-weight LLMs and multimodal models with optimized throughput and low latency.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning priced by usage.
features: Highly optimized serving stack (FireAttention) for speed
OpenAI-compatible API
Serverless and dedicated deployment options
Fine-tuning and LoRA adapter serving
Function calling and structured output support
Multimodal and embedding model support
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency, high-throughput inference on open models in production at competitive cost.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer-facing inference platform (strong in the China market) offering fast, cost-efficient APIs for a wide range of open-source LLMs, image, audio, and video models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, FLUX, and other popular Chinese and global open models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for LLMs and per-usage for image/audio/video models; free credits for new users; competitive low pricing.
features: OpenAI-compatible API
Broad support for leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
High-speed optimized inference
Fine-tuning and dedicated deployment options
Strong presence as China's open-model download share rises
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in China and Asia) seeking affordable access to leading open-source and Chinese-origin models via API.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely fast token generation for open-weight LLMs via API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference with aggressive low-latency pricing; free developer tier available.
features: Custom LPU hardware for ultra-low latency
Industry-leading tokens-per-second throughput
OpenAI-compatible API
Curated selection of popular open models
Simple developer onboarding
platforms.best_for: Developers needing the fastest possible real-time inference for chat and agentic applications.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API aggregator and router that gives developers access to many open and proprietary models across multiple inference providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passed through from underlying providers with a small routing margin; no subscription required.
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic routing, fallback, and price/latency optimization
Access to both open and proprietary models
Transparent per-model pricing comparison
Usage analytics and credit-based billing
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models without managing multiple API accounts.
